parsed.name: 同步 Unix 套接字客户端
parsed.description: 用于实验软件系统中的非物理通信组件，通过 Unix 域套接字与本机服务进程建立同步连接、发送消息并接收响应，适合本地控制服务、进程间通信和命令转发场景。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical communication component used in laboratory software systems. It establishes synchronous connections to a local service process over a Unix domain socket, sends messages, and receives responses for local control services, inter-process communication, and command forwarding.

actions.description: 检查是否已连接到 Unix 套接字服务器。
actions.description_en: Check whether the client is connected to the Unix socket server.

actions.description: 连接到 Unix 套接字服务器。
actions.description_en: Connect to the Unix socket server.

actions.description: 向服务器发送一条消息。
actions.description_en: Send a message to the server.

actions.description: 从服务器接收一条完整消息。
actions.description_en: Receive a complete message from the server.

actions.description: 以同步且互斥的方式发送消息并接收响应，避免线程间收发交错。
actions.description_en: Send a message and receive the response atomically with mutual exclusion, preventing interleaved send/receive operations across threads.

actions.description: 关闭与 Unix 套接字服务器的连接。
actions.description_en: Close the connection to the Unix socket server.
